Open a raster band as a lazy DataArray

Source: R/open.R
open_raster.Rd

Opens one band of a classic (2D) GDAL raster, such as a GeoTIFF or COG, as a DataArray with lazy altarr data and an AffineIndex built from the dataset's geotransform and CRS. Nothing but metadata is read until values are asked for.

Usage

open_raster(dsn, band = 1L, dims = c("x", "y"))

Arguments

dsn

Data source name (file path, URL, or GDAL DSN string)

band

Band number (1-based)

dims

Names for the column and row dimensions

Value

A DataArray with dims dims (columns first, as GDAL7 returns them)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
r <- open_raster("/vsicurl/https://example.com/dem.tif")
r  # coords: (x, y) affine ...
r |> sel(x = c(140, 150), y = c(-45, -40)) |> collect()
} # }
